I.O. D.1197
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTER
No. I. O. D. 1197.
Date. 3 ... 5 ... 30.
May 3, 30.

Dear Mr. Milton,

With reference to your letter, dated
April 24, 1930, concerning the whereabouts of one
W. Rees Harris, I have to inform you that exhaustive
enquiries have been made to ascertain whether this
person left Yokohama for Shanghai on January 4, 1930,
and passenger lists of vessels leaving the first
named port for Shanghai for a week prior and a week
after January 4, 1930, were scrutinized, but without
result. General enquiries locally have also proved
abortive.

Yours sincerely,

M. Milton Esq.,
Vice-Consul,
H.B.M. Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记簿
编号：I. O. D. 1197。
日期：30年5月3日。
1930年5月3日。

尊敬的米尔顿先生：

关于您1930年4月24日来信，查询W. Rees Harris之下落一事，谨此奉告，我方已进行详尽调查，以核实此人是否于1930年1月4日自横滨前往上海。经查核1930年1月4日前后一周内，从上述港口驶往上海的各轮船乘客名单，均未发现结果。本地的一般性查询亦无收获。

此致
敬礼

M. Milton 先生，
副领事，
英国驻上海总领事馆，
上海。

Special Branch
(Foreign Section)
(C.I.D.) Office Notes
File No. D 1197.
May 1, 1930.

Sir,

Reference the attached letter from Mr.
M. Milton, British Vice Consul, concerning the
present whereabouts of W. Rees Harris.
Exhaustive enquiries have been made to ascertain
whether the named gentleman left Yokohama for
Shanghai on January 4, 1930. Passenger lists of
vessels leaving the first named port for Shanghai
for a week prior and a week after January 4, 1930
have been examined, without result. All other local
sources of enquiry have been tapped without bringing
to light anything of a definite nature.

W. Moore.
D. P. S.

1930年5月1日。

先生：

兹附呈英国副领事M. Milton先生来函，查询W. Rees Harris目前之下落。
我方已进行详尽调查，以核实该绅士是否于1930年1月4日自横滨前往上海。经查核1930年1月4日前后一周内，从上述港口驶往上海的各轮船乘客名单，均未发现结果。所有其他本地查询渠道均已排查，但未发现任何确切线索。

W. Moore.
副警务总监。

PASSPORT & REGISTRATION
BRITISH CONSULATE GENERAL
P.O. BOX 128.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REGIST: D. 1197.
SHANGHAI.
Date 25 - 4 - 30.

24th Apr. 1930.

Dear Mr. Aiers,

We have received an enquiry from the
Consulate at Tokyo as to the present whereabouts
of a Mr. W. Rees Harriss.

This gentleman is a journalist and he left
Singapore for Japan on 23.9.29 by the S.S. "Fran-
ken", and it is known that he registered at the
new grand hotel, Yokohama, on Jan. 3rd last. He
left the following day, ostensibly for Shanghai.

I should be very grateful for any informa-
tion you may possess regarding this man as his
relatives are anxious to receive news of him.

Yours sincerely,

M. Willson
Vice Consul.

R. C. Aiers, Esquire,

Lr. No record in
C.I.D. Reg.
[Signature] 25/4.

Foreign Section,

邮政信箱128号。
上海公共租界工部局警务处
登记号：D. 1197。
上海。
日期：30年4月25日。

1930年4月24日。

尊敬的艾尔斯先生：

我方收到东京领事馆的查询，询问W. Rees Harriss先生目前之下落。

这位绅士是一名记者，他于1929年9月23日乘坐“弗兰肯”号（S.S. "Franken"）轮船从新加坡前往日本，据悉他于去年1月3日在横滨的新格兰德酒店（New Grand Hotel）登记入住。他于次日离开，声称前往上海。

如蒙提供有关此人的任何信息，不胜感激，因其亲属急切盼望得到他的消息。

此致
敬礼

M. Willson
副领事。

R. C. Aiers 先生，

来信。刑事侦缉处登记簿中无记录。
[签名] 4月25日。

外侨科，
请予调查并报告。
[签名]
